plantMenu.title: Plant in the watered bed
plantMenu.hint: Planted things sprout right away and grow in over a minute or two.

goalsIntro.title: Now: set your own goals
goalsIntro.body: Nicely done — you've got the hang of it! From here, the board is yours. Set your own goals — craft something specific, plant, collect materials, read up on animals, welcome wildlife, or upgrade your home — and track them right here. You can hold three at a time.

welcome.coopHint: Restore a shared preserve with friends — host one for a join code, or join with a friend’s code.
welcome.soloHint: Your own private preserve, just for you.

intro.title: Welcome to Wild Willows
intro.lede: A cozy game about bringing a worn-out nature preserve back to life, at your own pace. No failing, no timers — just you and the land.
intro.gatherText: Wander the meadow and pick up seeds, branches, and stones that nature has let go.
intro.craftText: Turn what you gather into plants, ponds, and shelter, and place them around the land.
intro.welcomeText: As the land heals, animals find their way home — click any one to meet it.
intro.unlockText: Fully restore a biome and the trail to the next one opens — a whole new place to bring back.
intro.reassure: New here? When you start, a friendly guide walks you through your first steps — there’s nothing to memorize.

hud.coopBadgeTitle: Co-op preserve — invite & see who's here (U)
hud.healthHint: Raise health by watering the land and adding habitat — dig a bed and water it, plant flowers and trees, and place crafted pieces. Every bit of restored habitat nudges it up.
hud.balanceHint: Balance reflects how complete the animal community is — not just how many are back, but the variety. Welcome a mix of animal kinds (insects, birds, mammals…) and especially the predators at the top, who only return once the animals they feed on are here. It reaches 100% only when every animal has returned.
hud.dayTimerTitle: The preserve clock — a full day passes in about 24 minutes.
hud.demoGoalTitle: Welcome animals back to the meadow to complete the free demo.

how.basket: Your gathering tool — walk to any gathering spot and interact to collect it into your basket.
how.shovel: Terraform — dig soil beds in nearby ground; dig a shaped tile again to clear or drain it.
how.watering-can: Terraform — water a soil bed to make it plantable; water it again to flood it into open water. Chain water tiles into ponds, rivers, and lakes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changePasscodeHint: Enter your current passcode and choose a new one (4–32 characters). You’ll use it the next time you load this save.
settings.errPasscodeLength: Your new passcode must be between 4 and 32 characters
settings.deleteSaveHint: Deleting "{name}" permanently removes the preserve, journal, chests, and all progress from Harper. Enter your passcode to confirm.
settings.exportSaveHint: Download a copy of this preserve — world, journal, progress, and your caretaker’s name and look — as a single file. Keep it as a backup or move it to another computer.
settings.musicHint: The preserve’s background music and soft nature sounds.
settings.soundEffectsHint: Little sounds as you play — footsteps, picking things up, planting, and notification chimes.

keybinds.title: Controls
keybinds.unsupported: That key can't be used — pick a letter, number, or arrow key.
keybinds.note: Movement and interact each have a main key and an alternate — both work, and you can rebind either. Rebinding a key that's already in use swaps the two.

settings.reduceMotionHint: Stops UI animations, weather particles like rain and snow, camera pans when you travel, and the day-and-night lighting cycle — the view stays still and evenly lit.
settings.simpleTextHint: Uses shorter sentences and everyday words across the whole game, including the animal notes. Nothing is hidden — it is just said more plainly.
settings.interactHintHint: Show the pulsing ring and key badge over things you can interact with.

colorblindHint.off: Colorblindness affects up to 1 in 12 people. Pick the type that fits you and the game recolors itself, raises contrast, labels weather and time of day, and holds steady daytime light so nothing depends on color alone.
colorblindHint.redgreen: Red–green (deuteranopia and protanopia) is the most common type — reds and greens look alike. This shifts those hues apart in the world, adds high contrast and text labels, and steadies the lighting.
colorblindHint.blueyellow: Blue–yellow (tritanopia) is rarer — blues and greens, and yellows and pinks, are hard to tell apart. This separates those hues in the world, adds high contrast and text labels, and steadies the lighting.
colorblindHint.mono: Achromatopsia is seeing little or no color at all. This renders the game in black and white and leans fully on contrast, outlines, and text labels instead of color.

settings.feedbackHint: Spotted a bug, or have an idea for the preserve? Send a note straight to the developer.
settings.emailPlaceholder: Your email (optional — only if you'd like a reply)
settings.feedbackQueued: We couldn't send that just now — your feedback is saved and will go out automatically next time you start the game.
settings.highContrastHint: Deepens the text, borders, and accent colors until everything meets the WCAG AA readability standard — while keeping the warm cream-and-green look.

kbGate.title: Wild Willows needs a keyboard
kbGate.body3: , and reach for your basket, tools, and journal with shortcut keys — so it doesn’t work on a phone or tablet on its own.
kbGate.hint: Open Wild Willows on a computer, or connect a keyboard and press any key to begin.

demo.doneTitle: Thanks for playing the Wild Willows demo!
demo.doneBody: That's the end of the free demo — thank you for restoring a corner of the preserve. The full game opens five more biomes to restore, deeper crafting, seasons and weather, a field journal to fill, and many more neighbors to bring home.
demo.doneCta: Grab the full game to keep restoring the preserve.
demo.exportHint: Downloaded the full game? Save your meadow here, then Import Save on its title screen to pick up right where you left off.
demo.exportFail: Couldn't export the save. Try again?
